description: Unique and hidden weapons you can get for free in GTA VI story mode (gang-operation loot, world pickups, challenge and mission rewards, Ultimate Edition weapons), with a pin on Rockstar's official Leonida map where the place is mapped. Each weapon has a precision: exact (an interactive-map marker or mapped place), street (a street or landmark named by guides) or area (district or region only). Pins are converted from community-map game coordinates and are good to about 1 to 2 percent of the map (15 to 30 map pixels). chapterOrder is the story chapter a guide says the weapon becomes available in; 0 means no chapter gate is stated (open-world pickup you can reach whenever you can get to the spot). Gang-operation weapons are 1 because Illegal Operations open after the Chapter 1 mission Gone Fishing. Most guide sites repeat IGN's wiki or PowerPyx, so two guides agreeing is weaker than it looks; 'verified' is true only when at least two sources agree and nothing conflicts. Shop-only weapons are not listed individually; see the 'Gun shops' entry. Every row names its sources.

weapons.title: Pete's KZ-59
weapons.area: Back-room table in the hangar at Sundown Private Airfield, Leonard County (Chapter 4)
steps: Wait for Pilot Pete's phone call early in Chapter 4 (shortly after the mission Pool Day).
Go to the marked airfield in Leonard County (Sundown Private Airfield).
Enter the hangar and go through the red door into the back room.
Take Pete's KZ-59 from the table, then open the safe with code 3718 for loot (PowerPyx).
weapons.notes: Assault rifle with a black frame and leather furniture. Mission 'The Last Mile: Passing the Torch (Recover Pete's Plane)'. Single walkthrough source (PowerPyx; vicecity.codes repeats it); IGN lists the weapon without a location. Pin is the Sundown Private Airfield marker (GTA6Map.io).

weapons.title: Duval Signature ES9
weapons.area: Ultimate Edition weapon: Jason's own pistol, claim at an Ammu-Nation weapons locker
steps: Own the Ultimate Edition and advance the story until the weapon is unlocked.
Go to any Ammu-Nation (gun store).
Open its weapons locker and redeem the Duval Signature ES9 (Jason).
weapons.notes: Ultimate Edition only. PowerPyx says Ultimate Edition content unlocks gradually as you advance the story, so it is not all there at the start. Military pistol with a sleek, plain look (IGN). The Rockstar image shows both UE pistols together (title 'Weapon Variants'); which is which is inferred from IGN's descriptions. Sources disagree on timing: PowerPyx gives no chapter; the GTAVibes video roundup says Jason's Duval ES9 comes in Chapter 1 (so chapterOrder 1 is from that single source). No map pin.
